summary: The expedition screen hosts the isometric board: P7's select/order/words/hotkey controls move onto the 3D board with the same meaning and the same request_travel path, the 2D ExpeditionRouteBoard is deleted with its callers repaired, BoardPalette reads the Theme through ThemeTokens, and the three distances become the screen's camera modes.

coordination.notes: P11 owns palette adoption everywhere except game/scripts/world/ and game/scripts/board/, which are this lane's; nothing under game/scripts/ui/, game/scripts/shell/, game/scripts/battle/, godot-rust/, content/ or tools/ is edited here. S18 owns the bridge and native_expedition_port.gd; this lane needs no port change and makes none. game/themes/bronze_vellum.tres is P5's and gains no token here: BoardPalette derives the board's clay, sea, rock, land and the six faction washes from tokens the Theme already carries rather than adding new ones or keeping its own hex.
